correctness.rationale: Smoothness is equivalent to a² != 4; the sixteen coefficient polynomials of f^5 were reconstructed over F11[a]. The resulting 4x4 Hasse-Witt matrix has determinant (AB)² and rank 2, semilinear square zero exactly at the five exceptional parameters. Genus-two quotients of two commuting involutions supply an isogeny forcing supersingularity, not merely p-rank zero. Norm/discriminant show quartic irreducibility and exactly five geometric roots; Ohashi–Kudo isomorphism criterion yields three classes. Standalone script confirms coefficient extraction and arithmetic checks; no finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The principal 2023 dihedral-normal-form study supplies the model, sparse Cartier method and isomorphism criterion but classifies superspecial rather than characteristic-11 non-superspecial supersingular members. The 2023 mass formula gives only a weighted nonordinary count and explicitly leaves a-numbers unknown in general. The new exact five-parameter/two-invariant/three-geometric-class statement is neither reported nor implied by those results without further computation and isogeny arguments; targeted searches found no stronger direct result. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent calculation is acknowledged.

value.rationale: The nonordinary locus in this natural genus-four dihedral family was previously constrained by a weighted mass formula without a-number information. The complete exact characteristic-eleven determination supplies all exceptional parameters, their p-rank/a-number and Newton type, and their geometric isomorphism partition. The distinction between a-number 2 and p-rank 0 and the genus-two quotient argument is mathematically substantive and not simply an arbitrary finite sample.
